University of Bath GREAT Scholarship India 2025 is an opportunity offered by the University of Bath in collaboration with the British Council's Study UK campaign. Under this programme, students from 15 countries including India will receive financial support to pursue postgraduate study in the UK. A selected Indian student will receive a partial tuition fee of £10,000 for one year of study.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
hold an offer from the University of Bath to pursue a full-time, postgraduate taught master's course starting in 2025
have an outstanding academic background or relevant work experience
be classified as an international student for tuition fee purposes*

The students will pay the full international tuition fees for their chosen postgraduate course. This scholarship is intended to partially offset this cost, but applicants will still be responsible for the remaining fees.
A selected Indian student will receive a partial tuition fee of £10,000 for one year of study.
A scanned copy of the undergraduate degree certificate
A scanned copy of the postgraduate degree certificate, (if any)
A scanned copy of the final degree transcript or the most recent transcript, (if the applicant is still studying)
Payment slip of the application fee, if applicable
A personal statement, explaining the reasons for wishing to study the course
Proof of English proficiency, if English is not the applicant's first language
An authorised translation of the degree certificate and transcript, if they are not in English
An academic reference from the current or most recent place of study (
It is required only when the applicant has one or a professional reference and doesn't have an academic reference available from the last 10 years)
Name of the country in which the applicant has lived for the past three years

After applying, selected students will receive the offer to study at the university and will be automatically considered for the scholarship.
Candidates must submit their deposit payment simultaneously with their acceptance reply on the Application Tracker website to secure the offer.
Acceptance onto the course will only be confirmed once the deposit has been received.
Upon receiving their offer letter, students have a four-week window to complete their deposit payment.
The candidates will be selected based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
